_about: The documented dataset selection for the Odyssey challenge: which real public sample answers which condition of the brief, and why. All other samples under datasets/ are supporting inputs for the 'unseen sample' picker. compliance.py reads this file and checks each case against the actual results.
selection_policy: Own selection from public archives (ENA/SRA). No other team's prepared test pack is used. No sequence or record was created or edited. Where the archive does not contain a requested case, the gap is reported rather than filled.

poor_quality.why: Real field sample with 361 reads: human DNA, short fragments, low-quality and unrelated sequences. Unusable, so the verdict must be Retake sample.
poor_quality.condition: A poor-quality sample containing short fragments, many N bases, unrelated sequences, or human contamination; rejected with a written reason per sequence; unusable means 'Retake sample'.

mixed.why: Mock community A2 (15 fish tissue DNAs, 'equal concentration gradient'). The archive states the number of fish mixed but the per-species table is in the linked paper, which could not be retrieved, so only the count is checked.
mixed.condition: A mixed sample containing 5 identifiable species, with source-supported information to check the estimated share of each species.

unknowns.why: Real freshwater sample with many fish not in the reference list and primer-dimer fragments.
unknowns.condition: Marks unrecognized sequences as unknown, shows the closest match and confidence, and places them in a review queue; never confirmed, never full confidence.

bad_records.why: 5,119 real archive run records from five countries; they contain future dates, repeated sample IDs, missing/outside GPS pins. Species double spellings come from real RefSeq names in the reference.
bad_records.condition: Real records with a duplicate sample ID, a GPS pin outside the selected boundary, a future date, and a species name with two spellings; reject or merge each with a written reason; the database stays clean.

invasive.why: Real sample in which Nile tilapia and African catfish are detected at species level.
invasive.condition: A real sample that crosses the danger rule raises an alert with map pin, species name and threat level.

seasons.why: Same four sites sampled in 2019-08 and 2019-11.
seasons.condition: Real samples from the same location for two seasons, shown on a map with a season slider: detected, new, not detected, counts.

report.condition: A button that prints a one-page PDF: animals detected, risk level, source and sample date, uncertainty or missing coverage, and the action for the officer.

excluded_from_this_challenge.data/demo_survey: Simulated community generated from reference sequences: synthetic, not real data.
excluded_from_this_challenge.testing_data/: Test pack that ships with the upstream eDNA pipeline; the brief forbids another team's prepared test pack.
excluded_from_this_challenge.data/india_goa, india_goa_reef, india_la: Real public projects used by the QIIME2 pipeline path. Not reorganised here so that pipeline is not disturbed, and not used as challenge evidence.
